measures.name: electricity_industrial_price
measures.label: Industrial electricity price
measures.calculation: population-weighted county mean, of the state's EIA price applied to each county in it

measures.name: household_poverty_rate
measures.label: Household poverty rate
measures.calculation: Cadastre's share computed from ACS counts

measures.name: places_adult_population
measures.label: Adult population, 18 and over (CDC PLACES)
measures.unit: people aged 18+ (Census 2023 county estimates as published in CDC PLACES)

measures.name: places_obesity
measures.label: Adult obesity, age-adjusted (CDC PLACES)
measures.unit: percent of adults, age-adjusted (CDC PLACES 2025 release, 2023 BRFSS model-based county estimate); metro value is Cadastre's adult-population-weighted average of CDC county estimates
measures.calculation: mean of member counties weighted by Adult population, 18 and over (CDC PLACES), over the counties with a value (unavailable where those hold under 80% of it)

measures.name: unemployment_rate
measures.label: Unemployment rate
measures.unit: percent of labor force, annual average
